# Josef Dula

> Senior backend engineer (Kotlin/Java) from banking and payments who builds AI agents on deterministic foundations. Prague, Czechia. Open to new roles.

Helped build Partners Banka (Czechia) from scratch: cards team from day one, full Visa integration (Click to Pay, Apple Pay), clearing at scale, and the first in-bank bitcoin purchase in Czechia (backend and architecture lead). Member of the bank's AI group (AIVengers) and Tech Lead Platform. Previously backend developer and briefly CTO at Trisbee (payments startup), and integration developer at Provys.
